decision.label: inconclusive
decision.scope: Inconclusive ON THE MECHANISM, and CLOSED ON THE CHASE.
decision.vocabulary_note: Justified against every alternative: not support (no prediction exists to support), not weaken or reject_scoped (no hypothesis, and both forbidden on this run set), not replicate (dispatches nothing), not pause as a lane call.

THE_RULING.statement: THE SHIFT IS NOT ESTABLISHED AS ANYTHING. It is a second upper-tail draw, and no locus for a deterministic component survives.
THE_RULING.ground_1_the_agreement_argument_is_empty: Under BOTH hypotheses the two draws come from the same law, so the DIFFERENCE statistic has likelihood ratio about 1. All evidential content is in the LEVEL: one fresh one-sided excursion at p about 0.017, of a statistic itself selected post-hoc from about ten, and the two p values are not multiplied. THIS WAS THE DISPATCHING SESSION'S OWN ARGUMENT AND IT WAS WRONG.
THE_RULING.ground_2_the_mathematics_cannot_host_it: BY DERIVATION. The mean-gap term plus the classical t-skewness bias total about +0.04 against an observation of about +0.33.

ground_3_the_last_locus_is_excluded_by_t.the_test: A fixed offset in BINS scales as sqrt(n)/sd, so +0.31 SEM at 100 replicates requires +2.5 to +5.6 SEM at 10,000 replicates.
ground_3_the_last_locus_is_excluded_by_t.independently_recomputed_by_the_dispatch: All ten reproduce exactly from the committed high-precision repaired leg against the exact analytic mean. Mean +0.3251 against a null standard error of 0.3162 - about 1.0 SE from zero, CONSISTENT WITH ZERO and decisively inconsistent with a fixed bins offset.
ground_3_the_last_locus_is_excluded_by_t.nobody_had_read_it: The quantity was preserved by PDC-9 and sat in the committed package unexamined until the red team read it.

THE_RULING.what_is_closed_and_how: Mathematics closed by DERIVATION. Code closed EMPIRICALLY for any fixed-bins-offset defect. The residue is a defect proportional to sem_rep - named, unexcluded, and NOT PROPOSED.
